guardEvidence.howCaught: Two registered controllers. lifeline-ingress-restart-signal: an unverified request (any rate) writes the lifeline-restart signal at most once per persisted 12 h gap (24 h once armed); the lifeline ignores a signal for its own version; the ratchet drives one request a minute for 48 h and across reconstruction. lifeline-secret-refusal-redrive: a refused held message is retried single-flight, stopping at the first refusal, with the gap doubling from 1 to 15 minutes; settles on the first delivered forward.
